name: Route Title Updater
description: Dynamically override and enhance route/page titles.
project_description:
Route Title Updater is a flexible developer-focused module for Drupal that allows administrators to dynamically alter, override, manage, and version route titles across the site — without modifying core, contrib, or theme code.

 This module is especially useful for SEO optimization, UX refinement, and enterprise-level title governance where default route titles are too limited.

 Installation 
 
 After enabling the module: Click Configure. 
 You will see a listing of all available routes from: 
 1. Custom modules

 2. Contributed modules

 Select any route that contains a route title. 
 Override the title based on your requirements 
 While editing the title, built-in SEO validation runs automatically. 
 
 No core hacks. No template overrides. No code changes required.
